point.title: Native Canvas Interaction
point.rationale: The tldraw Editor owns live geometry and native undo navigation. MappingEditorRuntime projects semantic state into shapes and commits settled gestures back to the controller. CanvasRuntime keeps renderer-local models, measurements, connection focus, and routing resources. This is an important ownership boundary between interactive frames and durable semantic changes.
